speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To determine the cause of these concerning "B symptoms," have you noticed any recent fevers or a specific pattern to your abdominal discomfort?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma (Clinical suspicion based on B symptoms and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy; confirm with biopsy and imaging). REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CTA, Abdominal_CTA.
